channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Now that’s a looker: The Twin Cities’ 10 most beautiful new restaurants of 2025
item.description: From Art Deco to modern, light-filled spaces, these newcomers gave us picturesque backdrops to enjoy steaks, pastas, burgers, global flavors and more.

item.title: St. John’s organ builder feels ‘enormous joy’ hearing the instrument played
item.description: Christian Metzler, a native of Austria, came to St. John’s campus in Collegeville, Minn., last year to carry on the tradition of making music.

item.title: Archbishop: ICE agents don’t plan to raid churches over holidays
item.description: Archbishop Bernard Hebda’s statement comes after Gov. Tim Walz warned of a possible surge of ICE agents in Minnesota in the next two weeks.

item.title: What’s open, closed on Christmas Day in the Twin Cities area
item.description: Most malls and big stores close early.

item.title: Enbridge owes nearly $3 million for breaching aquifer during Line 3 construction in Minnesota
item.description: The breach in Aitkin County was one of four discovered in Minnesota.

item.title: Woodbury officials unaware of plans for potential ICE facility
item.description: The Trump administration is reportedly considering a processing site to hold newly arrested detainees in the Twin Cities suburb.

item.title: Vikings-Lions preview: Can Max Brosmer lead a Christmas upset?
item.description: The former Gophers quarterback, starting for an injured J.J. McCarthy, is facing a tough challenge given the injuries to the Vikings offensive line.

item.title: For sale: Oldest remaining Norwegian Lutheran church in the U.S.
item.description: The Old Muskego Church is on the St. Paul campus of Luther Seminary, which is up for sale.
